newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Oakley 1997 estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Oakley 1997 estimates cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co shaved its forecast for Oakley Inc's profits in fiscal 1997 but kept the stock's rating at neutral.
-- Fiscal 1997 estimates were cut to $0.60 a share from $0.70, based on lower sales and gross margins, Gruntal analyst Michael Conn said in a research report.
-- Shares fell 3/8 to 8-5/8 and touched a new year low of 8-1/2 during intraday trading on Friday.
-- Although Oakley indicated it had some encouraging results from new products, the report said, Conn does not expect the company to show earnings growth in fiscal 1997.
"Oakley's sales to Sunglass Hut (International Inc) declined 50 percent in 4Q 1996 and management indicated a similar decline is possible in 1Q 1997 as well," the report said.
-- Conn expects a sharp decline in earnings in the first quarter of 1997 with incremental improvment throughout the year, the report said.
